---
title: "eMANDEVAL"
description: "Compare COVID-19 vaccine mandate designs on predicted public support, health outcomes and cost."
---

Comparing mandate designs is hard because public support, health benefit and cost
move together, and differ across settings. A design defensible on epidemiology can
be indefensible on acceptability, and the trade-off is rarely stated.

eMANDEVAL runs on preference estimates from discrete choice experiments on mandate
designs. Assemble a design and it returns predicted public support, expected health
outcomes, and a benefit-cost comparison against the alternatives.

For public health policymakers, researchers and partner agencies.

[Open eMANDEVAL](/eMANDEVA-DecisionAid-V18/){.open}

::: {.note}
Predictions are model outputs conditional on the estimated preference structure and
the sampled population. They are an input to a policy judgement, not the judgement.
Part of [MandEval](/research/projects/mandeval/).
:::
